about.title: About us
about.intro: Zarrin Daneh Torshiz Co., operating under the Zarrin Pesteh Bagheri brand in Kashmar, Razavi Khorasan, supplies, packs and exports pistachios and pistachio kernels to wholesalers, processors and international buyers.
about.activityBody: Our core activities include direct sourcing from growers in the Kashmar region, processing, grading, packing and preparing pistachios for domestic wholesale and export.
about.locationBody: Kashmar, Razavi Khorasan — one of Iran’s recognized pistachio-producing regions.
about.capacityBody: Annual supply capacity of more than 2,000 tons, suitable for recurring wholesale and industrial orders.
about.audienceBody: Domestic wholesalers, food and nut processors, and international buyers and trading partners.
